properties.displayName: QC - Privileges of a user were changed
properties.description: This analytic detects whether a user's privileges have been changed.
properties.query:
let queryPeriod = 14d;
let queryFrequency = 1d;
let p = CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Palo Alto Networks"
| where DeviceProduct == "LF"
| where isnotempty(DestinationUserName)
//Populates the 'DestinationUserPrivileges' field with 0s just so we have some data since there is an issue with field projection:
| extend DestinationUserPrivileges = iif(isempty(DestinationUserPrivileges), "0", DestinationUserPrivileges)
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(queryPeriod)..ago(queryFrequency))
| summarize OldPrivileges = make_set(DestinationUserPrivileges) by DestinationUserName;
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Palo Alto Networks"
| where DeviceProduct == "LF"
| where isnotempty(DestinationUserName)
//Populates the 'DestinationUserPrivileges' field with 0s just so we have some data since there is an issue with field projection:
| extend DestinationUserPrivileges = iif(isempty(DestinationUserPrivileges), "1", DestinationUserPrivileges)
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(queryFrequency)
| summarize NewPrivileges = make_set(DestinationUserPrivileges) by DestinationUserName
| join kind=innerunique (p) on DestinationUserName 
| where tostring(OldPrivileges) != tostring(NewPrivileges)
